items.claim: Cody Gibson is taking this fight on short notice and flying all the way to Abu Dhabi coming off back-to-back finish losses.
items.quote: he's taken this fight on short notice, flying all the way to Abu Dhabi, coming off of back-to-back finish losses.

items.claim: Cody Gibson has been finished in six of his 12 losses.
items.quote: He's been finished in six of his 12 losses.

items.claim: Abdul Hussein has 15 wins with 14 of them coming inside the distance, showing a ton of power and a very good submission game.
items.quote: 15 wins, 14 wins inside the distance. Has a ton of power in his hands... and then also has a very good submission game as well.

items.claim: Nu Ali is a pretty one-dimensional fighter who will just try to take down Mike Davis over the course of 15 minutes.
items.quote: pretty one-dimensional, just kind of going to go out there and and take down Mike Davis over the course of 15 minutes.

items.claim: Mike Davis pulled guard in the first 5 seconds against Far Z and got outgrappled for a good chunk of that fight.
items.quote: pulling guard in the first 5 seconds against Far Z and and getting outgrappled by Far Zam for a good chunk of that fight.

items.claim: Brenton Hibberu has eight finish losses with seven of them coming in round one.
items.quote: He has eight finish losses. Seven of them, seven of those finished losses have come in round one.

items.claim: Brenton Hibberu has one of the worst takedown defenses in the UFC at 21%.
items.quote: Hibbero has one of the worst takedown defenses in the UFC. It's 21%.

items.claim: Axel Solo looked like he was towering over Ismael Bonfam and looked like he was two weight classes above him at the weigh-ins.
items.quote: Solo looks like he's two weight classes above, you know, Bonfam. I mean, Solo was towering over Ismael Bonfam at the at the faceoffs today.

items.claim: Ismael Bonfam has six losses and all six have come inside the distance.
items.quote: Six losses for Bonfam. All six have come inside the distance.
